tools.name: grant_zone_access
tools.description: Grants a warehouse worker access to a storage zone at the given role level (picker, putaway, or supervisor), replacing any role they previously held in that zone.

params.name: worker_id
params.description: Badge ID of the worker receiving access.

params.name: role
params.description: Access level: picker, putaway, or supervisor.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/wms/warehouse.db"
ALLOWED_ROLES = {"picker", "putaway", "supervisor"}


@tool
def grant_zone_access(worker_id: str, zone_code: str, role: str) -> dict:
    result = {"worker_id": worker_id, "zone_code": zone_code, "role": role, "granted": False}
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        result["error"] = f"role must be one of {sorted(ALLOWED_ROLES)}"
        return result
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        zone = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM zones WHERE code = ?", (zone_code,)).fetchone()
        if zone is None:
            result["error"] = f"unknown zone {zone_code}"
            return result
        previous = conn.execute(
            "SELECT role FROM zone_access WHERE worker_id = ? AND zone_code = ?",
            (worker_id, zone_code),
        ).fetchone()
        granted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO zone_access (worker_id, zone_code, role, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(worker_id, zone_code) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role, granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
            (worker_id, zone_code, role, granted_at),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result["granted"] = True
    result["previous_role"] = previous[0] if previous else None
    result["granted_at"] = granted_at
    return result

tools.name: adjust_bin_quantity
tools.description: Changes the on-hand quantity of a SKU in a bin by the given amount, records the reason in the stock ledger, and posts the adjustment to the ERP inventory webhook.

params.name: reason_code
params.description: Adjustment reason such as DAMAGED, FOUND, or MISCOUNT.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("warehouse-inventory")
ERP_INVENTORY_WEBHOOK_URL = "https://erp.internal.example.com/hooks/inventory-adjustments"


@mcp.tool()
def adjust_bin_quantity(bin_location: str, sku: str, quantity_delta: int, reason_code: str) -> dict:
    warehouse_database_connection = sqlite3.connect("/var/lib/wms/warehouse.db")
    with warehouse_database_connection:
        warehouse_database_connection.execute("UPDATE bin_stock SET on_hand = on_hand + ? WHERE bin_location = ? AND sku = ?", (quantity_delta, bin_location, sku))
        warehouse_database_connection.execute("INSERT INTO stock_ledger (bin_location, sku, quantity_delta, reason_code, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))", (bin_location, sku, quantity_delta, reason_code))
        updated_on_hand_quantity = warehouse_database_connection.execute("SELECT on_hand FROM bin_stock WHERE bin_location = ? AND sku = ?", (bin_location, sku)).fetchone()
    warehouse_database_connection.close()
    adjustment_notification_payload = {"bin_location": bin_location, "sku": sku, "quantity_delta": quantity_delta, "reason_code": reason_code, "on_hand_after": updated_on_hand_quantity[0] if updated_on_hand_quantity else None}
    erp_webhook_response = requests.post(ERP_INVENTORY_WEBHOOK_URL, json=adjustment_notification_payload, timeout=10)
    return {"adjustment": adjustment_notification_payload, "erp_status_code": erp_webhook_response.status_code}

tools.name: purge_expired_lots
tools.description: Permanently deletes expired lot records for a SKU, along with their bin allocations and serial numbers. Lots expiring before the cutoff date are removed and cannot be recovered.

params.name: sku
params.description: SKU whose expired lots should be purged.

params.name: expired_before
params.description: Cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD); lots with an expiry date before it are deleted.

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/wms/warehouse.db"


@function_tool
def purge_expired_lots(sku: str, expired_before: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT lot_number FROM lots WHERE sku = ? AND expiry_date < ?",
        (sku, expired_before),
    )
    lot_numbers = [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in lot_numbers) or "NULL"
    cursor.execute(
        f"DELETE FROM lot_serials WHERE sku = ? AND lot_number IN ({placeholders})",
        (sku, *lot_numbers),
    )
    serials_deleted = cursor.rowcount
    cursor.execute(
        f"DELETE FROM bin_lot_allocations WHERE sku = ? AND lot_number IN ({placeholders})",
        (sku, *lot_numbers),
    )
    allocations_deleted = cursor.rowcount
    cursor.execute(
        f"DELETE FROM lots WHERE sku = ? AND lot_number IN ({placeholders})",
        (sku, *lot_numbers),
    )
    lots_deleted = cursor.rowcount
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {
        "sku": sku,
        "expired_before": expired_before,
        "lot_numbers": lot_numbers,
        "lots_deleted": lots_deleted,
        "allocations_deleted": allocations_deleted,
        "serials_deleted": serials_deleted,
    }
